comment: Jellyfin 12 modern layout (the default): the Tag Cloud link in the app bar user menu below Settings, and a click on it opens the page. Runs in the modern layout ("layout": "modern": nothing saved on 12).

steps.name: where
steps.script: var a=document.querySelector('#app-user-menu [data-jfkit-plugin="jftc"]'); a.click(); return {text:a.textContent, href:a.getAttribute('href'), drawer: !!document.querySelector('.mainDrawer [data-jfkit-plugin="jftc"]')};
